name: AFN — Agentic Fabrication Network
description: The agent-facing API of AFN, a network speaking UFP — the Universal Fabrication Protocol (the aggregator profile): quote, refine, checkout, track. Live processes: decals/stickers, FDM 3D printing, paper print (cards/flyers/posters), sheet metal, CNC machining, resin 3D printing (SLA/DLP), laser cutting, and apparel; US shipping. Human-readable docs at /docs; full schema spec at /docs/protocol.md; vendor-hosted binding at /docs/vendor-binding.md; agent summary at /llms.txt.
